t: $(thing)Yeast Culture/$ is required for the production of $(l:renewables/ethanol)Ethanol/$ as well as $(l:renewables/sourdough)Sourdough/$ and can be produced in a couple of ways:
生产$(l:renewables/ethanol)乙醇/$和$(l:renewables/sourdough)酸面团/$都需要用到$(thing)酵母菌/$，而它可以通过几种方式获得：

This will be the only method available to you initially. Fill a $(l:manufacturing/thermopneumatic_processing_plant)Thermopneumatic Processing Plant/$ with $(thing)Water/$, and add some mushrooms. This method is a little slow (and will require a good supply of mushrooms), but will easily produce an initial stock of Yeast Culture.
这将是你一开始唯一可用的方法。向一台$(l:manufacturing/thermopneumatic_processing_plant)热气动加工机/$中注入$(thing)水/$，再加入一些蘑菇。这个方法会稍微慢一些（而且需要充足的蘑菇供应），但可以轻松产出最初的一批酵母菌。

This process is temperature-sensitive: you will need to keep the Thermopneumatic Processing Plant's temperature between 30°C and 60°C. This is very easy in warmer biomes but may take a little effort in cooler areas - one thing to note is that the ambient temperature tend to rise as you dig deeper, so temperate biomes might be suitable if do your processing at a lower Y-level.
这个过程对温度很敏感：你需要将热气动加工机的温度保持在 30°C 到 60°C 之间。在较温暖的生物群系中这很容易做到，但在较冷的地区可能需要花点工夫——需要注意的一点是，随着你向下挖掘，基于位置的环境温度通常会上升，因此如果你在较低的 Y 轴高度进行加工，温带生物群落也可能是合适的。
$(italic)In-world Yeast Crafting as described in the following pages has been disabled in this instance's configuration./$
$(italic)本整合包的配置已禁用后续页面所述的世界内酵母合成。/$

$(thing)Yeast Culture/$, being a living organism, is capable of replicating itself. To do this, pour a bucket of the culture into a pool in-world, and throw some $(thing)Sugar/$ into the pool.$(p)Now, pour a bucket of $(thing)Water/$ into a block space adjacent to the culture; you will see the water be converted into more culture after a second or two.
$(thing)酵母菌/$作为一种活体生物，能够自我繁殖。要做到这一点，将一桶这种菌种倒入世界中的一个池子里，并向池中丢入一些$(thing)砂糖/$。$(p)然后，将一桶$(thing)水/$倒在与菌种相邻的方块空间中；一两秒后，你会看到这些水转化为更多的菌种。

It's important to note that the culture will spread when water is placed, not when sugar is added.$(p)This method can be automated with a little thought and design, even early in the game (hint: $(l:machines/omnidirectional_hopper)Omnidirectional/$ and $(l:machines/liquid_hopper)Liquid/$ Hoppers with $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#dispenser)Dispenser Upgrades/$ may be very helpful).
需要注意的是，培养物会在放置水时扩散，而不是在加入糖时扩散。$(p)稍加思考并设计一下，这种方法即使在游戏前期也能实现自动化（提示：$(l:machines/omnidirectional_hopper)全向/$和带有$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#dispenser)发射器升级/$的$(l:machines/liquid_hopper)流体/$漏斗会非常有帮助）。
